lines.zh: 长颈一摆，树梢就入口了
lines.en: One neck swing and the treetops are mine.

lines.zh: 四条柱子腿踩着平原走
lines.en: Four pillar legs carry me across the plains.
Every step shakes the ground.
Slow going; nothing hurries me.
My neck dips into the canopy.
My tail sweeps the bushes aside.

lines.zh: 侏罗纪的太阳照着我走
lines.en: The Jurassic sun walks with me.
These long bones move like a bridge.
Across the grassland, unhurried.

lines.zh: 中国的地层里挖出过我
lines.en: They dug my bones from Chinese stone.

lines.zh: 脑子里只有叶子，没有敌人
lines.en: Only leaves on my mind, no enemies.
Tender leaves up high smell best.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方草都伏了
lines.en: The grass bends where I pass.

lines.zh: 再大的个头也得一片片吃
lines.en: Even a giant eats leaf by leaf.
Trees crowd the river bend; I'll go there.
My foot comes down with a thud.
Neck raised, I see the far hills.
All my life I've hunted for leaves.
Standing still, I'm a living wall.
Wind slips along my long neck.
At this height, could I touch a cloud?
I'll rest a while; do as you like.
My chewing carries a long way.
My tail swings slowly, shooing flies.

lines.zh: 一百三十五点血肉，实打实
lines.en: A hundred and thirty-five points of solid flesh.
The sky is blue, the grass is green.
I rarely rage unless provoked.
Heavy bones, light heart.
My long neck hangs down to rest.

lines.zh: 平原上没什么能推倒我
lines.en: Nothing on these plains can topple me.
I look up; the sky's not dark yet.
My breathing is slow as the tide.
This meadow will feed me a long while.
You move first; I'm too lazy.
You're smaller than my ankle.

lines.zh: 抬头，你站在我长颈下面
lines.en: I look up: you're under my neck.
What do you want, little one?

lines.zh: 别站太近，我一转身就碰倒你
lines.en: Not so close; my turn would knock you down.

lines.zh: 我认得你的味道，是陌生的
lines.en: I know your scent, and it's new to me.
Is that thing in your hand edible?
Neutral, and I mean it.

lines.zh: 对视一眼，我先低头吃草
lines.en: We lock eyes; I lower my head to graze.
I stretch my neck to meet your eyes level.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛长在头顶两侧
lines.en: My eyes sit high on either side.

lines.zh: 你要是不动手，我也不动
lines.en: If you don't strike, neither do I.
Looking at you makes my neck ache.
It hurts, but my hide is thick.
You actually dared to hit me.
Even this thick hide is torn.
A long cry; the pain sits deep and dull.
I'll remember that blow.
Stop, I'm bleeding.
Even giants feel pain.
Even my long neck is trembling.
Pain has muddled my steps.
That one was vicious.
Pass that bunch of tender leaves over.
Is that grass in your hand? I smell it.

lines.zh: 跟着你走，只要还有叶子
lines.en: I'll follow, as long as the leaves last.
Stop waving it; just let me eat.
One leaf won't fill this appetite.

lines.zh: 侏罗纪的胃口，现代的量
lines.en: Jurassic appetite, modern-sized servings.
Walk slower; I can keep up.
Something tasty is just ahead.
My long neck comes down to your hand.
I'm not greedy, only hungry.
Leaves, I want leaves.

lines.zh: 你手里那点，塞牙都不够
lines.en: That handful won't even fill a tooth gap.
Following food is only natural.
A bit closer, I can't reach.

lines.zh: 香味把我四条腿都带走了
lines.en: The smell is walking my four legs for me.
I won't snatch; I'll wait till you set it down.
You hit my leg and bounced off.

lines.zh: 对不起，没看见你这么小
lines.en: Sorry, I didn't see you down there.

lines.zh: 一步下去，你可别站那儿
lines.en: Don't stand there when my foot comes down.
This bulk hits hard.
Hitting me is like hitting a wall.
I'll shift aside; you may pass.
My neck swung and caught you.
Slow, yes, but I can't stop at once.

lines.zh: 让让路，我这体格不好拐弯
lines.en: Make way; I don't turn easily.
Did I step on you? Sorry.
Necks entwine in greeting.
Are you here looking for a mate too?
The plains are wide enough for us both.

lines.zh: 我这副骨架，得配同样大的
lines.en: This frame needs an equal beside it.
Come closer slowly, no rush.
Let's find a good meadow together.
A low call, and that's my yes.

lines.zh: 两头长颈并排，像两座桥
lines.en: Two long necks side by side, two bridges.
Spring comes slowly in the Jurassic.
We walk the same path.
That leaf on the ground is mine.
I lower my head and pick up something green.
Fallen fruit shouldn't go to waste.

lines.zh: 长颈低下去捡东西真费劲
lines.en: Bending this neck to pick things up is real work.
This thing smells like grass.
I lift it and chew slowly.

lines.zh: 地上有什么我都想尝一口
lines.en: Whatever's on the ground, I'll taste it.
Fallen leaves suit me fine.
Don't fight me for it; I reach slowly.
This tiny bite won't fill the gap.
You struck me, so don't blame me.
I've marked you; you can't outrun me.
Neck up, target ahead.
I really didn't want to fight.
A low bellow, that's your warning.
Now you're in my sight.
Don't assume I won't hit back.
When a giant starts moving, it's trouble.
This footstep is aimed at you.
There's nowhere to hide on open plains.
I follow you, step for step.

lines.zh: 你跑到哪，我脖子转到哪
lines.en: Wherever you run, my neck turns.

lines.zh: 你停下，我的脖子就到了。
lines.en: If you stop, my neck will reach you.
My neck's shadow chases you.
I'm slow, but I don't give up.
I hear your footsteps clearly.
Step by step, the gap closes.
I've been watching you a long while.
Turn around: I'm still here.
Even at the plains' end, it's still me.
A sweep of my long neck.
If I step on you, that's bad luck.
My tail lashes out.
This charge will send you flying.
A giant's fist is its leg.
I bring my head down hard.
Two tons of greeting.
Stay back, I'm swinging my neck.
Remember this blow.
My strikes are slow, and very heavy.
A long neck rises from the mist.
I've stomped this quiet plain awake.

lines.zh: 侏罗纪的风又吹起来了
lines.en: The Jurassic wind is blowing again.
Heavy bones, heavier steps.

lines.zh: 一百三十五点血肉站起来了
lines.en: A hundred and thirty-five points of flesh stands up.

lines.zh: 我走进这片草地，慢慢来
lines.en: I walk into this meadow, slowly.

lines.zh: 中国的化石，如今会走了
lines.en: A Chinese fossil walks now.
The treetops stir; that's me arriving.
Another long-neck is born.
Don't panic, I eat grass.
I hear the plain breathing.
My long neck rises above the treeline first.

lines.zh: 皮都焦了，我甩脖子退开
lines.en: My hide is scorched; I swing my neck away.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下，骨头都在响
lines.en: I fell from a height and my bones clatter.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻孔，我拼命抬头
lines.en: Water fills my nostrils; I strain to lift my head.

lines.zh: 爆响过后，我的长颈还在震。
lines.en: After the blast, my long neck is still ringing.
Something has stuck into my hide.
This pain isn't like a blade's.
Too few leaves; hunger makes me restless.
Lightning struck my long neck.
The void pulled the soil out from under me.
